name: Spotlight Compulsion
body:
School enchantment (Compulsion) [Mind-Affecting]; Level: jester 1

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area: 20-ft.-radius burst
Duration: 1 round
Saving Throw: Will negates; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause the targets to become averse to being close to other creatures. If a target ends its turn adjacent to another creature, it takes 1d6 points of phrenic damage.
